subject: SummitAI renewal — exec approval needed for safety-net retention package
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitai.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: tom.reynolds@summitai.com, procurement@summitai.com
Date: 2026-10-07T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — pricing pressure and potential consolidation

Logan,

Quick note from our leadership call this morning — SummitAI is under pressure to tighten spend ahead of Q4 budgeting. The platform ROI narrative is solid, but finance is pushing a consolidation review and any renewals will need to show immediate unit-cost savings.

We love Redwood (team is superb) and our usage patterns have grown, but ops wants a stronger SLA for mission-critical models and a short-term credit to offset migration costs. Specifically:
- a one-time amortized credit to cover migration validation (~$40k)
- a 6-month term reset (move renewal date to align with fiscal cadence)
- a targeted SLA bump to 99.95% for our inference-critical routes during business hours

Can you or your team map what’s feasible? We’d like a written proposal by Friday. If not possible, we’ll have to evaluate alternatives.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Product 
SummitAI

Attachments: SummitAI_Renewal_KPIs.pdf (summary of usage and cost targets)

From: logan.wright@redwood.com <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — pricing pressure and potential consolidation

Asha — appreciate the transparency and the timeline. We don’t want to lose SummitAI. I’m putting together a short retention proposal and will loop in pricing & finance for final approval. High-level options we can consider:
- One-time transition credit: $35k–45k (depends on audit of validation scope)
- Short term reset: align to 12/31/2027 (6–15 months depending on final start date)
- SLA overlay: add a monitored 99.95% SLA on selected inference routes with 4-hour incident response + credits for breaches

Ben, Lauren — can you review the ask below and advise on what we can offer from a deal desk perspective (discounts, credit band, and SLA feasibility)? I’ll deliver a written offer to Asha by Friday COB.

Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, Oct 7, 2026 at 08:15 AM Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitai.com> wrote:
> Logan,
>
> Quick note from our leadership call this morning — SummitAI is under pressure...

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SummitAI renewal — internal options

Team — reviewed SummitAI usage and the KPIs Asha attached. Short summary and recommended ranges:
- One-time credit: $40,000 (we can stretch to $45k with a commitment to a 12-month minimum consumption baseline)
- Discount: offer a 12% weighted discount on compute tokens for first 12 months post-renewal (tiered down after that)
- Term reset: move renewal to 12/31/2027 (adds ~15 months of coverage from prior term) — requires legal signoff but standard
- SLA add-on: 99.95% during business hours (Mon–Fri 8am–6pm PT) with a 50% service credit for gross breaches; requires engineering to sign an operational runbook and an SLA addendum (POI_SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf attached)

Risks/notes:
- Credit + discount is borderline on margin; recommend approval from Vivek for above-the-line credit.
- SLA: engineering needs to pre-approve the monitored routes and define outage windows so we can accurately calculate exposure.

Ask for exec: approval for $45k one-time credit + temporary 12% discount and signoff to execute the SLA addendum. If we get that, we can lock a renewal for 24 months and retain expansion upside.

Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POI_SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf, pricing_breakout.xlsx

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.kcom>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-08T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitAI renewal — exec approval request

Ben / Logan — I saw the numbers. Approve the one-time credit up to $45k provided we get:
1) a written commitment to a 12-month minimum consumption baseline (document clause drafted by legal)
2) the SLA scope must be narrowly targeted to the two named inference routes in the addendum and include an agreed maintenance window schedule
3) include a clause that limits escalation credits to direct service credits (no cash refunds)

If those conditions are in the agreement, I’m okay to greenlight the concession. Please get legal to draft the amendment and route for signature.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, Oct 8, 2026 at 09:30 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — reviewed SummitAI usage and the KPIs Asha attached...

From: logan.wright@redwood.com <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: SummitAI renewal — retention proposal (approved)

Asha — thank you for the patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: we have executive approval to proceed with a retention package that addresses your key asks. High-level terms below — legal will follow with an amendment for signatures: 

1) One-time migration credit: $45,000 (applied on invoice following renewal execution).
2) Term alignment: Renewal date will be reset to 12/31/2027 (15-month extension from current cycle) once the amendment is fully executed.
3) Temporary discount: 12% weighted discount on compute token pricing for 12 months post-renewal.
4) SLA overlay: 99.95% availability for the two nominated inference routes during business hours (Mon–Fri, 8am–6pm PT). Remedies limited to service credits as defined in POI_SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf — engineering will provide the runbook as an attachment to the amendment.

Conditions:
- SummitAI to sign a 12-month minimum consumption commitment (clause in amendment).
- SLA scope limited to named routes; scheduled maintenance windows to be mutually agreed.
- Credits applied per the addendum; no cash refunds.

Next steps: legal will send an amendment draft (cc: procurement) by EOD Monday. If that timeline works, we’ll lock the package and schedule a short exec call for sign-off if procurement needs it.

Please acknowledge and I’ll push the amendment.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: POI_SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf, pricing_breakout.xlsx
